title: Installation Work Order and Warranty Start — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
Installation closes the work order and starts the Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty warranty. The set must be in status ordered when the installation is recorded; recording it moves the set to active.

- The install date is the work-order date, and the install odometer is the odometer written on the installation work order; both are copied from the work order and never estimated.
- Miles driven for every later warranty decision are measured from the install odometer.
- When the line includes a complimentary alignment check, the work order also carries that check, which records nothing on the set.
- A road hazard certificate sold on the same ticket starts its coverage on the installation, as the Road Hazard Protection terms set out.

**Example (hypothetical work order):** a work order closed with 31,200 on the odometer makes 31,200 the set's install odometer; an inspection later read at 52,200 shows 21,000 miles driven.
